{'text': 'iOS 27 已經正式登場，Siri AI 同多項全新 Apple Intelligence 功能固然係亮點，但我就最鍾意其中一個方便實用嘅新功能，可以將 iPhone 剪貼簿嘅內容快速貼上。即刻睇下點用！', 'source': "iOS 27 is now officially here. While the Siri AI and the various new Apple Intelligence features are certainly highlights, my personal favourite is a new convenience feature that lets you quickly paste content from your iPhone clipboard. Let's see how to use it right away!"}

{'text': 'iOS 27 喺鍵盤上方加入貼上快捷鍵，一鍵取用剪貼簿內容', 'source': 'iOS 27 adds a paste shortcut above the keyboard for one-tap access to clipboard content'}

{'text': 'Apple 每年都會為 iOS 加入大量新功能，今年嘅升級涵蓋 Apple Wallet、Messages、CarPlay 等多個範疇。', 'source': "Apple adds a host of new features to iOS every year, and this year's upgrades span Apple Wallet, Messages, CarPlay and more."}

{'text': '唔少新功能可能會被一般 iPhone 用戶輕易忽略。', 'source': 'A number of new features could easily be overlooked by the typical iPhone user.'}

{'text': '但當中有個 iOS 27 新增功能，我估讀者們實會成日用。', 'source': 'But one new iOS 27 feature, I suspect, readers will find themselves using all the time.'}

{'text': '當你將文字、連結或者相片複製到 iPhone 剪貼簿之後，再打開另一個文字輸入欄位，鍵盤上方就會出現貼上快捷鍵。', 'source': 'When you copy text, a link or a photo to your iPhone clipboard and then open another text field, a paste shortcut will appear above the keyboard.'}

{'text': '道理好簡單：如果你複製咗嘢，跟住即刻轉去另一個 app，或者開另一個文字輸入位，Apple 就知道你好大機會想即刻貼上。', 'source': "The logic is simple: if you've copied something and immediately switch to another app or open another text field, Apple knows you probably want to paste it right away."}

{'text': '所以毋須你再開個複製／貼上選單再按貼上，貼上建議會自動彈出喺鍵盤頂部，一鍵搞掂，方便快捷。', 'source': 'So instead of opening the copy/paste menu and tapping paste, a paste suggestion automatically pops up at the top of the keyboard — done in one tap, quick and easy.'}

{'text': '鍵盤頂部一欄仲會預覽剪貼簿嘅內容。如果係文字，你會見到段文字；如果係圖片，就會顯示一個細小縮圖預覽。', 'source': "The strip at the top of the keyboard also previews the clipboard content. If it's text, you'll see the snippet; if it's an image, a small thumbnail preview will be displayed."}

{'text': '呢個功能我自己從來唔會要求加入，但用過今個夏天嘅 iOS 27 beta 之後，發現日常使用非常方便。', 'source': "It's never a feature I would have asked for myself, but after using the iOS 27 beta over the summer, I found it incredibly convenient for everyday use."}

{'text': '你用咗 iOS 27 嘅新貼上快捷鍵未？歡迎留言分享！', 'source': 'Have you used the new iOS 27 paste shortcut? Leave a comment and share!'}
